remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600
    -DWINVER=0x600
    -DENTRY_PREFIX=QUARTZ_
    -DPROXY_DELEGATION
    -DWINE_REGISTER_DLL)

spec2def(quartz.dll quartz.spec)

add_typelib(control_tlb.idl)
add_rpcproxy_files(quartz_strmif.idl)

add_idl_reg_objects(quartz registry quartz_strmif.idl)
add_idl_reg_objects(quartz regtypelib control_tlb.idl)

# quartz.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/quartz-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(quartz_shims OBJECT acmwrapper.c avidec.c decoder.c dsoundrender.c filesource.c filtergraph.c filtermapper.c main.c memallocator.c parser.c passthrough.c systemclock.c videorenderer.c vmr7.c vmr7_presenter.c vmr9.c window.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proxy.dlldata.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/quartz_strmif_p.c)
target_link_libraries(quartz_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload strmbase strmiids uuid dxguid oldnames libdsound libmsacm32 libmsvfw32 libole32 liboleaut32 librpcrt4 libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libwinmm libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(quartz_shims)
add_dependencies(quartz_shims wineheaders dxsdk stdole2)
set(QUARTZ_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/quartz/control_tlb_t.o
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/quartz/quartz_strmif_r.o)
add_cargo_module(quartz quartz-cargo quartz.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS quartz_shims psdk quartz_r quartz_t ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/control_tlb.tlb;${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/quartz.rgs ${QUARTZ_REUSED} dxsdk uuid_sources)
